d: We are looking for an experienced engineer to help with our day-to-day activities, including integrating new sources and extending our ETL infrastructure. Our current system includes various tools and services such as workflow management systems, message brokers, a data lake, a data warehouse, and infrastructure-as-code tools. As the company grows, new teams are forming around the DE team, and they need help with their batch and streaming pipelines.
q: Programming skills, e.g., experience with several programming languages or Python frameworks
SQL skills, including the ability to apply subqueries, window functions, and CTEs
Computer science fundamentals - design patterns, network protocols, database design
Cloud systems experience (AWS, GCP, message brokers, object storage, query engines)
Databricks platform, delta tables, and PySpark
Experience with or a desire to learn infrastructure as code, e.g., AWS CloudFormation.

r: We also have ETL system process improvements that go along with team interactions. If you have good programming skills or knowledge in the data engineering field and want to join our development process, we are waiting for you. Although we value good programmers even if they lack experience in other areas, the following is the formal set of requirements that will help you in this future job:
Integrating new sources using the existing batch and streaming ETL system
Creating new real-time pipelines using an infrastructure-as-code approach
Supporting the BI team by investigating corner cases and working on data quality issues
Supporting teams in extracting data from the warehouse into their systems
Taking part in ETL systems migrations to ensure a consistent, performant, and scalable design.
